subject: Audit logs: request for access/export formats & retention
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Green <alice.green@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logs: request for access/export formats & retention

Hi Alice - great to meet today. Thanks for the time and for walking through FincoBank's requirements. Quick recap + asks so we can follow up with exactly what your security team needs: 

Recap
- FincoBank wants auditable evidence of who accessed what data and when for regulatory review.
- Key asks: export formats, fields included (e.g., user id, IP, role), PII handling/masking options, retention windows, and data residency options.

Action items / asks for Finco security
1) Can you confirm the exact retention window(s) you need for audit exports (e.g., 90 days, 1 year, 7 years)?
2) Which fields are considered PII that must be redacted or hashed on export?
3) Do you need exports in a particular format (CSV/JSON/Parquet) or a specific schema?
4) Any required signing/encryption (PGP) for transfer?

What we can provide (high-level)
- Continuous audit logging (API + UI) with time-ordered events: user, action, resource, resource id, timestamp, IP, region.
- Exports available as JSON/CSV/Parquet; can stream to S3 or provide ad-hoc export files.
- Field-level redaction/hash options for PII, and ability to configure retention per-account (enterprise plan).

Next steps
- If you can share your security questionnaire or the list of PII fields, Ben and Marissa will prepare a sample export (redacted) and a short doc on retention options.
- Happy to set up a technical call with your security team this week.

Thanks - I'll wait for the questionnaire and preferred retention window.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director of Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: audit_logs_export_schema.csv (CSV schema stub)

From: Alice Green <alice.green@fincobank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Finco Security <security@fincobank.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs: request for access/export formats & retention

Hi Sean - thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and attaching our questionnaire: 

- Retention: For most audit data we need 3 years online, with the ability to export and archive for 7 years on request. For some PII-linked events we may need 7-year retention depending on the data class.
- PII: Names, email addresses, national IDs, account numbers - these are the fields we need masked or hashed in exports (we can provide exact column list).
- Formats: Prefer JSON or Parquet for large exports; CSV ok for smaller exports.
- Transfer: S3 push with server-side encryption or PGP-encrypted attachments are fine.

Can you please provide:
- A sample export (redacted) showing the fields you capture (timestamp, actor, action, resource, ip, etc.)
- Confirmation of whether you can configure retention per account and how deletions are handled (proof of deletion/export logs)
- Confirmation of data residency - whether logs can be stored in a specific region (we prefer eu-west-1 for EU data)

I attached our security questionnaire (fincobank_security_questionnaire_v3.pdf).

Thanks,
Alice Green
Senior InfoSec Manager, FincoBank
alice.green@fincobank.com

Attachments: fincobank_security_questionnaire_v3.pdf (Security questionnaire PDF)

Subject: Re: Audit logs: request for access/export formats & retention

Hi Alice - thanks, and thanks Marissa/Sean for the handoff. Below is a concise summary of what Redwood can provide today and next steps: 

1) Export formats & delivery
- We can produce audit-log exports in JSON, CSV, or Parquet.
- Delivery options: ad-hoc downloadable archive, scheduled S3 export (TLS + SSE), or API streaming.
- We can also provide gzipped JSON exports for large ranges. Attached is a small redacted sample (audit_logs_export_sample.json.gz).

2) Default fields included (common schema)
- event_timestamp (ISO8601)
- actor_email / actor_id
- actor_role
- action (e.g., read, write, export, delete)
- resource_type (dataset/model/route)
- resource_id
- ip_address
- geo_region
- request_id / trace_id
- prev_state_checksum (if applicable)
- export_flag (true if the action produced an export)

3) PII handling
- Field-level redaction: you can choose to remove PII fields from exports.
- Deterministic hashing: we support salted hashing of fields (useful to preserve uniqueness without revealing value).
- Tokenization: we can replace identifiers with tokens and store mapping in a secure vault (enterprise option).
- All options can be configured per-account under enterprise subscription; for self-serve accounts we support deterministic hashing and removal.

4) Retention & deletion proof
- Configurable retention windows: 7 days, 30 days, 90 days (default), 365 days.
- Enterprise options for multi-year online retention (3 years) and archival workflows (S3 Glacier / long-term archive).
- Proof-of-deletion: we retain immutable deletion events (audit of the audit) and can provide signed deletion logs for compliance requests.

5) Data residency
- By default logs are stored in the region matching the account's primary region (US by default).
- For enterprise customers we support EU data residency (eu-west-1) and can ensure exports and storage remain in-region.

Next steps
- I attached a redacted sample export (audit_logs_export_sample.json.gz) and our standard export schema CSV.
- If Finco needs 3-year online retention and in-region storage in eu-west-1, we can scope that in an enterprise compliance addendum (I can draft a short SOW).
- Happy to set up a technical call - propose Fri 27 Mar 09:00 or Mon 30 Mar 14:00 (ET).

Let me know which time works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
